subject.title: [Feature] Configurable thinking/reasoning block format per channel

question: Should OpenClaw add a public reasoning display-format contract, and should precedence be per-channel, per-agent/global, or both?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix adds a public config/default surface that affects multiple channels and existing reasoning visibility semantics, so automation should not choose the product API.

options.title: Add Minimal Display-Format Contract
options.body: Preserve italic by default, support a small approved enum such as italic, code, spoiler, or blockquote, and document one precedence order across channel and agent defaults.

options.title: Limit To Telegram Formatting Policy
options.body: Defer shared agent config and resolve readability through Telegram-owned presentation or parse/text-mode work such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/10944.

options.title: Reject New Config For Now
options.body: Keep fixed italic rendering and direct users to reasoning visibility controls until a broader reasoning presentation design is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Add Minimal Display-Format Contract
recommendation.body: Preserve italic by default, support a small approved enum such as italic, code, spoiler, or blockquote, and document one precedence order across channel and agent defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history signal on reasoning visibility/display and prior review context already framed this as a product/API decision.
